title: Sticker pack
summary: Shows a sticker pack from a pack link or from a received sticker, and adds it to the user's packs (ADR 0205).

stateKey.description: The state key of the pack in the room. Empty for a pack link.

title.description: The pack display name, else the room name.

authorHandle.description: The @handle of the room creator from POST /v1/handles/resolve, for bipe_sticker_pack_by. Absent without a handle.

stickers.description: The images whose usage includes sticker or states no usage, in pack order.

phase.description: loading: a spinner. loaded: the pack and bipe_sticker_pack_add. added: bipe_sticker_pack_added. failed: bipe_sticker_pack_failed with bipe_app_retry.

appear.effect: Reads the room state im.ponies.room_emotes with stateKey over the client-server API. A public room the user is not in is read without joining (world_readable). If the pack is already in im.ponies.emote_rooms, phase added.

add.effect: Joins the room when the user is not in it, then adds roomId and stateKey to the global account data im.ponies.emote_rooms with a read-merge-write on the server copy. Then phase added; the pack shows in sticker-picker.

notes: Opens from a pack link (registries/stickers.json stickerPackLinkBase plus the room ID; the app handles it as a universal link and app link, and bipe-web serves the same path with the store links), and from message-actions viewStickerPack on a sticker that carries stickerPackField.
Adding a pack sends no message: it changes only the user's account data and joins a public room with no messages.
A room with no im.ponies.room_emotes at stateKey, or a room that is not world_readable and that the user is not in: phase failed.
